article.title: 完型 · 人类嗅觉并不迟钝
article.background: 科学解释型文章。把“人类嗅觉迟钝”的常识印象逐层推翻，重点突出受体机制、适应与陌生气味警报功能。

sentences.en: The human nose is an underrated tool.
sentences.zh: 人的鼻子其实是一件被低估的感官工具。
prosody_focus: The human nose is an underrated tool.

segments.text: The human nose is an underrated tool.

sentences.en: Humans are often thought to be insensitive smellers compared with animals, but this is largely because, unlike animals, we stand upright.
sentences.zh: 与动物相比，人类常被认为嗅觉迟钝；但这主要是因为我们不像动物那样贴近地面，而是直立行走。

segments.text: Humans are often thought to be insensitive smellers compared with animals, but this is largely because, unlike animals, we stand upright.

sentences.en: This means that our noses are limited to perceiving those smells which float through the air, missing the majority of smells which stick to surfaces.
sentences.zh: 这意味着，我们的鼻子主要只能感知飘散在空气中的气味，而会错过大多数附着在物体表面的气味。

segments.text: This means that our noses are limited to perceiving those smells which float through the air, missing the majority of smells which stick to surfaces.

sentences.en: In fact, though, we are extremely sensitive to smells, even if we do not generally realize it.
sentences.zh: 不过事实上，我们的嗅觉极其敏锐，只是通常自己并未意识到这一点。

segments.text: In fact, though, we are extremely sensitive to smells, even if we do not generally realize it.

sentences.en: Our noses are capable of detecting human smells even when these are diluted to far below one part in one million.
sentences.zh: 即使人的气味被稀释到远低于百万分之一，我们的鼻子仍能察觉。

segments.text: Our noses are capable of detecting human smells even when these are diluted to far below one part in one million.

sentences.en: Strangely, some people find that they can smell one type of flower but not another, whereas others are sensitive to the smells of both flowers.
sentences.zh: 奇怪的是，有些人闻得到一种花香，却闻不到另一种；而另一些人对两种花香都很敏感。

segments.text: Strangely, some people find that they can smell one type of flower but not another, whereas others are sensitive to the smells of both flowers.

sentences.en: This may be because some people do not have the genes necessary to generate particular smell receptors in the nose.
sentences.zh: 这可能是因为，有些人缺少生成某些特定嗅觉受体所必需的基因。

segments.text: This may be because some people do not have the genes necessary to generate particular smell receptors in the nose.

sentences.en: These receptors are the cells which sense smells and send messages to the brain.
sentences.zh: 这些受体就是感知气味并向大脑传递信息的细胞。
prosody_focus: These receptors are the cells which sense smells and send messages to the brain.

segments.text: These receptors are the cells which sense smells and send messages to the brain.

sentences.en: However, it has been found that even people insensitive to a certain smell at first can suddenly become sensitive to it when exposed to it often enough.
sentences.zh: 然而，人们发现，即便起初对某种气味并不敏感的人，只要接触得足够频繁，也可能突然变得能够感知它。

segments.text: However, it has been found that even people insensitive to a certain smell at first can suddenly become sensitive to it when exposed to it often enough.

sentences.en: The explanation for insensitivity to smell seems to be that the brain finds it inefficient to keep all smell receptors working all the time but can create new receptors if necessary.
sentences.zh: 嗅觉迟钝的一种解释似乎是：大脑认为让所有嗅觉受体始终工作并不经济，但在必要时可以生成新的受体。

segments.text: The explanation for insensitivity to smell seems to be that the brain finds it inefficient to keep all smell receptors working all the time but can create new receptors if necessary.

sentences.en: This may also explain why we are not usually sensitive to our own smells — we simply do not need to be.
sentences.zh: 这也许还能解释，为什么我们通常察觉不到自己的气味——因为根本没有这个必要。

segments.text: This may also explain why we are not usually sensitive to our own smells — we simply do not need to be.

sentences.en: We are not aware of the usual smell of our own house, but we notice new smells when we visit someone else’s.
sentences.zh: 我们察觉不到自己家中习以为常的气味，却会在走进别人家时注意到陌生的味道。

sentences.en: The brain finds it best to keep smell receptors available for unfamiliar and emergency signals such as the smell of smoke, which might indicate the danger of fire.
sentences.zh: 大脑似乎认为，最好把嗅觉受体留给陌生气味和紧急信号，比如可能预示火灾危险的烟味。
